shortDescription: Noel Tata-led Tata Trusts said the reappointment of Chairman N. Chandrasekaran to Tata Sons is void, according to Bloomberg.The statement marked the trust's second dissent after the board asked Chandrasekaran to continue for five more years.

title: Tata Trusts Reiterates Chandrasekaran Reappointment to Tata Sons Is Void
